node: Cloud cybersecurity and automation infrastructure: identity, machine identity, secrets management, observability, data pipelines, compliance automation, and secure industrial AI workflows
summary: Layer 1B expansion found one reference anchor and three underfollowed public candidates tied to the AI-era control plane: identity/security platform consolidation, AI/cloud/OT exposure management, regulated compliance automation, and observability/security telemetry. The best underfollowed lane is not generic AI software, but mandatory infrastructure used to govern, secure, audit, and troubleshoot AI-enabled enterprise workflows. CyberArk and Confluent would have been strong standalone candidates historically, but current evidence indicates CyberArk was acquired by Palo Alto Networks in February 2026 and Confluent was acquired by IBM, so they are treated as context rather than standalone discovery candidates.
